context: Geography documentary: Asuka and Riku on regions and neighbors.
purpose: WIDENED SCENARIO: geography discussion; regional vocabulary (県/区/都市/側) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 大きな都市は、どこにありますか?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm earnest engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 都市は、海の側に多く集まります。
lines.en: Cities gather mostly near the sea.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 県の中に、区もあるんですか?
lines.style: engaged teen boy voice, soft warm curious throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 大きな都市は、いくつもの区に分かれます。
lines.en: Big cities split into many wards.
lines.style: patient teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: ドイツの都市も、そうなんですか?
lines.en: Are German cities like that too?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ドイツにも、区に似た仕組みがあります。
lines.en: Germany too has a system like wards.
lines.style: composed teacher voice, soft warm measured informative clarity throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 山の側には、都市は少ないんですね。
lines.en: There are few cities on the mountain side.
lines.style: understanding teen boy voice, soft warm engaged throughout

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 県ごとに、地形が違って面白いですよ。
lines.en: Terrain differs by prefecture, which is interesting.
lines.style: warm teacher voice, soft warm measured encouraging clarity throughout
